title: Orbit Architecture
summary: An architecture portfolio concept that lets visitors understand one house through its exterior, floor plan and interiors. Here is how we organised the project page and built the prototype.
alt: Orbit Architecture project page beside a lakeside house at dusk

sections.title: The brief
sections.text: Give a small architecture studio a portfolio that can explain a project before the first call. The visitor should be able to see where the house sits, understand the layout and get a sense of what it is like inside.

sections.title: Three ways to read one project
sections.text: The exterior establishes the setting. The plan shows how the rooms connect. The interior view lets visitors see materials and light at room scale. Each view belongs to the same project, so exploring the house never means starting over in a different gallery.

sections.title: What we designed and built
sections.text: We defined the project structure, designed the portfolio and built an interactive demo. A production version could give an editor fields for the location, drawings, captions and image groups. Orbit is a studio concept. The house, brief and prototype illustrate the design approach.
